_schema: Two kinds of override, applied on top of the dial's default verdict. component_overrides apply globally, everywhere that element name appears. pair_overrides apply only to a specific parent->child relationship — for when an element is fine on its own but is a coincidental shape-match in one specific context (see 貝/目 below).

component_overrides.reason: Corpus-structural frequency (12 characters) undercounts real-world importance — 毎日/毎年/毎回 are among the most common words in the language. Frequency-in-the-writing-system and frequency-in-actual-use aren't the same axis; this is the case that proved it.

pair_overrides.reason: 目 (eye) is a coincidental stroke shape-match inside 貝's decomposition, not a real perceived sub-meaning — 貝 is understood as an atomic shell/money pictograph, not "eye + eight". Surfacing it would teach a false association. Scoped to this pairing only; 目 elsewhere is unaffected.
Same reasoning as 貝/目 above — coincidental shape match, not real compositional meaning.
